liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **El Paso** (1 review): Reviewer calls El Paso superb, praising Bob's vocal and John's solo as sweet [12]
- **Birdsong** (1 review): Birdsong jam features John's envelope filter runs [14]
- **Lost Sailor-Saint Circumstance** (1 review): Reviewer loved Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance opening the second set [13]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Reviewer hears Viola Lee Blues as a powerful, magical blues performance and essential listening [13]
- **Dear Prudence** (1 review): Reviewer calls Dear Prudence a bust-out that brought smiles all around [13]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Listener singles out Black Muddy River as a highlight of the recording [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **TLEO**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [20]
- **Candyman**: rare: 8 archived performances [20]
- **Bob Chat register to vote**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Lost Sailor-Saint Circumstance**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Drums with Oteil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **deadco2016-06-23.neumannmatrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 174 min [1]
- **dc2016-06-23**: source not stated; 16 songs; 170 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **DCO2016-06-23.akg463.flac24**: source not stated; 16 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 9 [3]
- **deadco2016-06-23.neumannusm69i**: source not stated; 16 songs; 174 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer rates this Birdsong jam among the best the band has played [14]
- Reviewer finds tempos on old standards much slower than before, with songs stretched out, typical of Dead & Company shows [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2016-06-23.neumannmatrix**: taped by Nate Evans; transferred by Nate Evans; source: Neumann Matrix USM69i/AK40/AK50 [1]. Also: Taped from section 102, row X, seat 33, about eight feet up, near the soundboard; Source is usm69 matrix; editing and tracking were done in SFPro, with a stream on SoundCloud [1]
- **dc2016-06-23**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Source: DPA 4023 > Zoom F8 (24/48) [2]
- **DCO2016-06-23.akg463.flac24**: taped by taperjeff; transferred by taperjeff; source: Akg 463 PAS>Lunatec V3>Tascam DR-60 (24bit/48 kHz) [3]
- **deadco2016-06-23.neumannusm69i**: taped by Nate Evans; transferred by Nate Evans; source: Neumann USM69i [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.abebooks.com: [Dead and Company - 2016 Summer Tour - Poster - Bristow, VA - Jiffy Lube Live, June 23, 2016: Very Good (2016) 600 printe](https://www.abebooks.com/Dead-Company-2016-Summer-Tour-Poster/31613555686/bd) [21]
